rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Emily Post
rows.Origin:
Bred by Roy L. Byrum (United States, 1974).
Introduced in United States by Joseph H. Hill Co. in 1974 as 'Omega'.
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 1977 as 'Omega'.
rows.Bloom: Pink to peach, seashell-pink shading. Moderate fragrance. up to 48 petals. Average diameter 3.75". Large, very full (41+ petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, mounded, upright.

Height: 32" to 35" (80 to 90cm).
